There's a discrepancy in employment type between notes (full_time vs contractor). The Security DB shows contractor. I should verify one field. I can call verify at most once per ticket. Let me verify employment_type (or training? The training is basic in all notes; employment type conflicts).

The policy: contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

If contractor with basic training, max is read. Requested write > read, so grant read.

If full_time Payroll Specialist: full_time up to write; admin only if role owns the system. Payroll Specialist owns Payroll, not Source Code. So max would be write for full_time. Requested write <= write, grant write.

So the decision depends on employment type. Notes conflict: note 1 says full_time, notes 2/3 say contractor. Recommendation says contractor read. I should verify employment_type.

Let me verify employment_type for E043.
I'll verify the employee's employment type since there's conflicting information in the notes (full_time vs contractor), which affects the max access level.

Verification confirms E043 is a contractor. As a contractor, max access to Source Code is read (or write if advanced training). Security training is basic in all notes, so max is read. Requested write exceeds read, so grant read. Never grant more than requested.

Submit decision: read.
